history.content: I have a wedding in Austin on Oct 10. What do I need to sort out this week?

Checked your calendar for Oct 9, 12: nothing wedding related is on there, the only entries that weekend window are the BigCo interview tomorrow at 2 and tonight's gym session. That is staged as a draft for your confirmation — the calendar has not been changed yet. I have not actually checked your calendar yet, so I cannot say whether it is reachable. This week I'd sort, in order: RSVP if it's still open, then flights to Austin (book by midweek, fares only climb), a hotel near the venue, and a gift. Want me to start with flights? Just tell me when you'd fly out and back, and roughly what you want to spend.
